remedies: Use a small sewing needle or paper clip to unplug.

symptoms.symptom: Burners have yellow or yellow-tipped flames or flames lift off the port

causes.label: The combustion quality of burner flames needs to be determined visually.
remedies: A–Yellow flames     B–Yellow tips on C–Soft blue flames Call for service    outer cones             Normal for natural Normal for LP gas gas
If burner flame looks like A, call for service.
Normal burner flames should look like B or C, depending on the type of gas.
NOTE: The grill burner will show orange flames from grease drippings.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "The combustion quality of burner flames needs to be determined visually."

causes.label: Burner parts not replaced correctly.
remedies: See Care and cleaning of the cooktop section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Burner parts not replaced correctly."

causes.label: Burner has not been used recently.
remedies: A “cold” burner ignited in the HI setting may have some flame “roar” or “lifting.” This should dissipate after 4 to 5 minutes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Burner has not been used recently."

symptoms.symptom: Burner flames pulled toward vent grille

causes.label: Vent fan set at HI speed.
remedies: This is normal.
If cooking performance is affected, change fan to a lower fan speed setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Vent fan set at HI speed."

causes.label: Changing blower speed.
remedies: This is a typical electrical switching noise.
This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 35: "Changing blower speed."

remedies: See the Care and cleaning section.

causes.label: Flame setting may need

causes.label: Controls improperly set.
remedies: To turn from the OFF position, push the knob in and then turn.
The knob can only be turned in a counterclockwise direction.
When the knob is at any other position, it can be turned in either direction without being pushed in.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 35: "Controls improperly set."

causes.label: Cord improperly connected or power turned off.
remedies: Check connections.
Turn on power at the fuse box.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 35: "Cord improperly connected or power turned off."

causes.label: Clogged filter.
remedies: Clean filter per instructions.

causes.label: House too airtight.
remedies: Open a window slightly to provide fresh air source.

causes.label: Wall cap obstructed.

causes.label: Wall cap damper door stuck.
remedies: Check exterior wall cap damper door for free movement or obstruction.

causes.label: Duct length exceeds recommended 100 equivalent foot maximum.
remedies: Reduce number of elbows to simplify duct run.

causes.label: Food spillovers not cleaned before next use.
remedies: See the Care and cleaning section.
Cover pan with a lid.
Turn the downdraft fan OFF until the water begins to boil.
